look_here_first: Start with the perennial clump and leaves: mostly basal/lower lanceolate leaves, long nearly leafless peduncles, and large all-yellow heads.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: basal and lower lanceolate to oblanceolate leaves

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: outer phyllaries narrow; inner phyllaries broader and united near base

lookalikes.differences: Unlike annual C. wrightii, C. lanceolata is clump-forming and perennial with broader lanceolate lower leaves and long nearly leafless stalks.
